response.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), transaction_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS transaction_share FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(transaction_share) AS average_share FROM transaction_shares GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;
